items.action: Remove the `staggerMs` attribute or `[staggerMs]` binding from every ds-pie-chart.
items.appliesWhen: ds-pie-chart only. `staggerMs` on the other charts and on the chart series is unchanged and still spaces their arrivals.
items.verify: No ds-pie-chart element carries a staggerMs attribute or binding, and the app compiles.

items.action: None, unless a screen relies on the dark tooltip panel on the light theme: set the three --ds-chart-tooltip-* colours on :root as in restore. Delete an override that only restated the new light colours (delete list: chart-tooltip-light-override-redundant).
items.appliesWhen: Every chart tooltip panel on the light theme, which ships in styles/tokens-charts. The dark theme is unchanged.
items.pitfall: A screenshot test of an open chart tooltip on the light theme changes, and a page styled to sit a dark panel on a light card loses that contrast.
items.verify: On the light theme an open chart tooltip panel computes a light background, unless the app sets --ds-chart-tooltip-bg-color on purpose.

items.action: Rename cursorPin to pinOnClick on every ds-chart, in static attributes and [cursorPin] bindings alike.
items.appliesWhen: ds-chart only. pinOnClick on the preset charts is unchanged, and DS_CONFIG.chart.pinOnClick still sets the default.
items.verify: No template binds cursorPin, and the app compiles.

items.action: Replace tooltipAnchor="point" with tooltipAnchor="reading" on ds-line-chart, and 'point' with 'reading' in any typed field bound to [tooltipAnchor].
items.appliesWhen: ds-line-chart only. dsLineSeries already took 'reading'; ds-column-chart's tooltipAnchor takes 'mark' | 'cell' and is unaffected.
items.verify: No ds-line-chart binds tooltipAnchor to 'point', and the app compiles.

items.action: Where your code reads area back from a LineChartSeries or a dsLineSeries data entry, handle 'fade' as well as true and false.
items.appliesWhen: Only code that READS area; building a series with area: true or false needs nothing.
items.verify: Every read of a series' area handles the 'fade' value, and the app compiles.
items.note: The type widened from boolean to boolean | 'fade'; 'fade' fills from the line down to nothing at the baseline.

items.old: BarChartComponent, ChartComponent, ColumnChartComponent, FunnelChartComponent, HeatmapChartComponent, LineChartComponent, PieChartComponent, ScatterChartComponent, WaterfallChartComponent, SparklineComponent, LineSeriesComponent, ChartTooltipDirective
items.action: Build after upgrading, and rename or mark `override` every member of yours the compiler reports as colliding.
items.appliesWhen: Only a class of yours that extends one of the listed charts. Template users need nothing; subclassing a DS component is unsupported.
items.pitfall: A subclass that overrode a shared input such as caption or frame now shadows the base class member: it compiles only with `override`, and a redeclared input.required data breaks against the optional base.
items.verify: The app builds with no TS4114 or TS2416 against a DS chart class.
items.note: The shared chart inputs and their resolved signals moved to an internal base class; ChartTooltipDirective gained host, LineSeriesComponent fadeId, SparklineComponent area, WaterfallChartComponent dimOthers and tooltip; data, categories and series became optional. The compiler names every collision.

informational: ds-table's exportCsv() and runExport() log a warning in a development build when the table has no dsTableExport, where they threw NG0203 from the calling click handler.
provideDsConfig and provideDsIntl merge several calls in one providers array in order, the later winning per key, where the last call used to replace the others.

A dsLineSeries with tooltip="axis" opens its category panel under the default cursor="auto", where the category cursor used to stay off unless two or more marks showed a tooltip. A cursor="category" set only to make that panel appear is redundant (delete list: chart-cursor-category-for-axis-tooltip).

deleteList.why: cursor="auto", the default, turns the category cursor on for any mark with tooltip="axis".
deleteList.replaceWith: nothing; keep it on a plot whose marks do not use tooltip="axis", where it is what turns the cursor on

deleteList.why: The panel takes --surface-overlay, --text-primary and --border-default by default, so an override setting those light colours restates it.
deleteList.replaceWith: nothing; keep an override that sets any other colour
